observation_summary: The chi-square test statistic calculation returned incorrect values when the sum of observed counts did not equal the sum of expected counts.
reasoning_summary: The implementation of the Chi-Square test statistic calculation assumed that the sum of observed counts and the sum of expected counts were identical. In statistical practice, when these sums differ, the expected values must be rescaled to match the total observed count to produce a valid test statistic. The original code failed to perform this normalization, leading to incorrect results when the input arrays had different sums. The fix introduces a ratio calculation to rescale the expected values when the sums are not equal, ensuring the statistical validity of the test.
